scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cdls/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,api,web --prefix-colors gray,magenta,cyan "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cdls/shared && npm run build -w @cdls/api && npm run build -w @cdls/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cdls/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @cdls/shared && npm run test:e2e -w @cdls/api
